speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of an ovarian mass, ascites, and pleural effusion with a normal CA-125 is classic for Meigs syndrome, typically caused by an ovarian fibroma. I will request imaging to confirm the solid nature of the mass. REQUEST IMAGES
